newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Bovespa trades $14.1 billion in April.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Bovespa trades $14.1 billion in April.

text.p: Market turnover at the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange (Bovespa) in April totalled $14.1 billion, with an average daily volume of $670.5 million, up 16.3 percent from March, the bolsa said Monday.
The spot market accounted for 89.6 percent of total trade, followed by the options market with 9.8 percent and the forward market with 0.6 percent, it said.
The stock exchange also said the Bovespa index, now comprising the 48 most liquid stocks, rose 10.4 percent in April.
